gloss: to perform surgery; to operate on

definitions.gloss: to perform surgery; to operate on
definitions.explanation: To carry out a medical operation on a patient's body, typically involving incisions. Can describe both performing surgery (from the doctor's perspective) and undergoing surgery (from the patient's perspective).

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ}する⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I'm scheduled to have surgery next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ}した。
examples.english: The doctor operated on the patient's knee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腫瘍|しゅよう}→腫瘍：23364_shuyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Surgery is necessary to remove the tumor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。

notes:
Composed of {手|しゅ} (hand) and ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (technique, art). As a suru-verb, it can mean both to perform surgery (from the doctor's perspective) and to undergo surgery (from the patient's perspective), depending on context.

USAGE:
- Doctor perspective: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧が〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ}する (to operate on ~)
- Patient perspective: {手術|しゅじゅつ}する / ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to have surgery)
The body part operated on is marked by ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to undergo surgery
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧: the surgery succeeds
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: operating room
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧{台|だい}: operating table
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: post-surgery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オペ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to operate — colloquial, from German "Operation"
- ⟦{施術|せじゅつ}→施術：20663_sejutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to perform a procedure — broader, includes non-surgical medical procedures and beauty treatments
- {切開|せっかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to incise, to make an incision — specifically the act of cutting open
